alerts.title: Renal Function Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring renal function with LFTs and RFTs. Patient's creatinine level has increased from 0.8 mg/dL to 1.1 mg/dL since starting TDF, which may indicate renal impairment. Non-drug causes such as pregnancy-related changes should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor renal function closely and adjust TDF dose if necessary
